verdict.rationale: A domain registrar could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, such as domain or DNS suggestions, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Name.com. The MCP servers only let external AI agents call the API or search the docs, which is an adjacent building block and not in-product AI analysis of user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
